newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Buba's Issing-no rate cut under current situation.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Issing-no rate cut under current situation.

text.p: Bundesbank Chief Economist Otmar Issing said on Friday that "under existing circumstances," there could be no rate cut in Germany.
But asked whether he had ruled out any rate cuts forever, as he seemed to have done on German television on Wednesday, Issing said: "Of course not. There is never an end."
Issing was speaking as he arrived for the annual meeting of the European Mortgage Federation.
